The purpose of the procurement is to acquire a VDES base station solution and related shore-side capabilities for use in Fintraffic Vessel Traffic Services’ maritime traffic management environment. The solution and related services shall support the implementation, management, monitoring and operation of the VDES base station system in accordance with the requirements set out in the procurement documents.
